newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto buy repeated.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Thursday she reiterated her buy rating on agricultural firm Monsanto Co following a recent meeting with management.
-- "The stock has now recovered from the hit it took over worry about dilution on the Holden acquisition, and we expect continued improvement from here," Wittenburg said in a report.
-- The company has not closed yet on its planned $1.0 billion acquisition of Holden's Foundations Seed Co, and the related Corn States Hybrid Service and Corn States International.
-- Wittenburg said Monsanto expects the Holden acquisition to close in the second quarter and its previously announced planned spin-off of its chemical operations to occur around September.

-- Managers of Monsanto's genetically engineered Bt cotton and Roundup ready soybeans expect technology fees of $32 per acre and $5 per bag, respectively, will hold for another two or three years, she said.

-- Monsanto expects 8-10 million acres of Roundup ready soybeans in the United States this year, and noted that seed companies probably could have sold seed for twice that acreage if seed was available, the analyst said.

-- The analyst said Monsanto indicated not all Bt cotton seed available will be sold this year because the Bt gene is in limited varieties at this point and 35 percent of the target market was penetrated already in 1996.
